text:
frank.ops: Quick one  my partner had an acute appendicitis and had a laparoscopic appendectomy while we were in Rome. They billed us at discharge and we need to figure out direct billing vs reimbursement. I don't have the company digital card on my phone.
nora.benefits: Oh no, hope they're ok. Can you share member full name, DOB, last4 of member ID, date of service, hospital name/address, and a photo of the itemized bill?
frank.ops: Member: Elena Rodriguez / DOB 1993-10-11 / member last4 8811. Date: 2030-04-02. Hospital: Ospedale San Giovanni, Via delle Botteghe Oscure 4, Rome. Paid receipt link: https://files.redwood.example/RCPT_20300402.jpg
samar.hr: Glad she's recovering. For surgeries abroad, carriers sometimes allow direct billing for emergencies. Nora  any SLA or docs needed?
nora.benefits: Tagging intl-bot  we need operative report, discharge summary, itemized invoice showing CPT equivalents (or local procedure code), and provider tax ID. If member paid and we have docs we can start an expedited overseas reimbursement.
intl-bot: [auto] Case created: INT-SURG-40421. Please upload: operative report, discharge summary, itemized invoice, and proof of payment. Preliminary coverage check in progress.
clinic-billing: [clinic] We can submit claim to insurer if provided with authorisation/guarantee letter and full member ID. Our billing prefers emailed guarantee to billing@ospedalesg.it. We have local procedure code 'APP-LAP' but can map to CPT 44970 on request.
frank.ops: Uploading the discharge summary and operative note now: https://files.redwood.example/OP_NOTE_0402.pdf
nora.benefits: Received. We'll request a letter of guarantee and advise clinic to reference CPT 44970 (appendectomy, lap). For international mapping we also include ICD-10 K35.80.
intl-bot: [auto] Update INT-SURG-40421: preliminary coverage: emergency inpatient surgery covered under travel rider. Authorization number PROV-2030-04-987 issued pending final review. Letter of guarantee to be emailed to member and clinic within 24 hours.
samar.hr: Frank  if the clinic still charged you, keep all original receipts and any payment method proof. Finance may expedite a bridging payment if needed.
frank.ops: They charged us EUR 4,600 at discharge. I paid with our company travel card by mistake. Do we need to re-route the charge?
nora.benefits: If the company card was used, please send the transaction details to finance and mark expense as "medical-charge". We'll coordinate with carrier to reimburse the company or reclassify. If member paid personally, we'll process reimbursement to the member.
intl-bot: [auto] Final: Letter of guarantee emailed and carrier claim opened CLM-2030-04-5502. Clinic billing confirmed receipt and will submit claim referencing PROV-2030-04-987 and CPT 44970. Expect adjudication in 15-45 days. Please upload any EOBs and final invoices to HRA under "international inpatient".
frank.ops: Clinic confirmed they got the guarantee and will bill Aetna directly; thanks everyone. Closing here but will reopen if EOB doesn't match. :pray:
